prompts.checkout: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a polished square 1:1 checkout illustration for the parents course about supporting an autistic child through frustration. The attached image is the character identity and visual style reference. Preserve the same three characters: blonde psychologist Vivianne in a black sleeveless outfit; curly brown-haired mother with tortoiseshell glasses, navy T-shirt and jeans; boy with dark wavy hair, black glasses, navy T-shirt, charcoal trousers and red sneakers. New centered compact composition designed to remain legible as a small checkout card: mother seated near her son at his eye level, psychologist on the other side offering calm guidance. Gentle attentive expressions, the boy still a little frustrated, no exaggerated tears, no magical instant cure. Premium warm 3D animated illustration, soft fabric and hair details, cream background, simple lilac and pale yellow organic shapes. Show complete heads and hands, generous margins, balanced center of gravity. No text, no letters, no price, no number of lessons, no logo, no watermark, no UI.

Warm premium 3D animation illustration, faithful faces and clothing, cream minimal room, lilac and pale yellow accents matching reference, uncluttered generous composition. Both figures centered with all heads and hands inside safe margins. No text, letters, logos, watermark, puzzle piece or autism emblem, no medical apparatus. One cohesive scene.
prompts.oferta-acolher: Use case: illustration-story. Create one landscape 3:2 supporting illustration for a parents course about helping an autistic child during and after frustration. Soft cream setting, lilac and pale yellow organic background, warm gentle light, premium detailed 3D animated illustration faithful to the reference. Center the characters and show complete heads and hands with generous safe margins. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, puzzle emblem, medical equipment. One cohesive scene.
